verdict.rationale: Datadog's APM/tracing docs and unified platform (docs-23, docs-13, docs-1) support correlating traces with logs and metrics via tagging, and community evidence corroborates this as a core competitive strength ("correlate data across APM, custom metrics, and logging through tagging"). One competing community voice claims correlation is weaker than rivals, but this is general sentiment/opinion rather than a concrete documented failure, so it doesn't rise to disputed. Missing for 10: a hands-on walkthrough or independent benchmark specifically confirming span-to-log/metric click-through UX, and no first-party doc excerpt detailing the exact trace-to-log pivot feature.
